study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
prior vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
recurring indication for prior cesarean delivery
cohort: 1295 women with 1 prior low transverse cesarean delivery undergoing TOLAC with a vertex singleton pregnancy in the preterm period (26-36 weeks)
finding: A predictive model for successful VBAC in the preterm period was developed and validated, with significant predictors including chronic hypertension, hypertensive disease of pregnancy, prior vaginal delivery, cervical dilation on admission, prior VBAC, recurring indication for prior cesarean delivery, induction of labor, and interactions between these variables.
